VGK.head: This one sets up well for Vegas
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Toronto’s only real way in is pouncing on loose pucks, and it would need a near-perfect night.

TOR.head: Everything points away from Toronto
TOR.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Toronto could still pull it off if it pounces on loose pucks, but it might need a miracle.
